items.title: Wall Street’s Fear Index Just Hit 9.7. History Says the S&P 500 Could Rally 10.5% in 3 Weeks
items.summary: Panic has gripped Wall Street, and the last time sentiment sank this low, buyers who stepped in were rewarded within weeks. Three signals will show whether this selloff is ending or only halfway done.

items.title: Renaissance Technologies Opened $739 Million in New Positions in Three Big Banks
items.summary: The quant giant behind the Medallion Fund just piled into three Wall Street heavyweights, then watched those stocks tumble within days of the filing. Does a 13F snapshot reveal conviction, or only a moment already gone?

items.title: Goldman Sachs admits the ‘AI unwind’ has spiraled into something more dangerous — and it’s watching for 3 signs of bottom
items.summary: Hedge funds have trimmed AI bets, but Goldman says mutual funds, ETFs and futures traders remain heavily invested, even with indexes in a correction.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Just Dropped 14% in a Week. Is It Time to Sell, or Load Up?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGoldman Sachs stock fell 14% in the past week, more than the S&P 500 and Morgan Stanley, as an AI-led selloff spread to bank stocks. Nearly half of the drop came Friday.

items.title: SpaceX Is Paying Up to 8.36% on $44 Billion of Debt for Nvidia Chips
items.summary: Lenders lined up to fund SpaceX's chip spree, then demanded a steep price for it. The real risk may be what happens to those GPUs, and to SpaceX's cash flow, before the first rent check clears.

items.title: The Dow Jones Did Something It Hasn’t Done Since October 2008
items.summary: Five brutal sessions erased nearly all of the Dow's 2026 gains, yet the biggest AI name barely moved the index. Two high-priced stocks did the real damage, and the last time this happened, a rally fooled almost everyone.

items.title: This Dividend ETF Could Supercharge Your Passive Income. Here's How.
items.summary: Most income investors trade growth for yield. This ETF lets you have both.

items.title: Report: Goldman Sachs Predicts the S&P 500 Will Gain 26% in 12 Months
items.summary: Despite a rocky few weeks on Wall Street, the next 12 months are looking much more bullish, according to Goldman Sachs.
